selection_blinding: E42 view/donor/K rules frozen before outer-target outcomes; donor deltas use first halves; gene truth uses target second halves
consumer_training: control-only nonlinear MLP; 4,800 train and 1,200 held-out control cells; 256 held-out starting states per shift

predeclared_gates.apparatus: actual-perturbed consumer cosine > 0.5 and native steering beats mismatch before and after generic removal
predeclared_gates.optimized_arm: mean advantage over mismatched perturbations > 0.05, its hierarchical-bootstrap lower bound > 0, and generic-removed advantage > 0.10 with lower bound > 0

conclusion: Both zero-label optimization rules pass a nonlinear, control-trained consumer steering assay in both MLP variants. Best-single is the stronger and more stable deployable rule; architecture-balanced also steers perturbation-specific expression but is harmed by the scVI outer-target case.
evidence_boundary: This establishes that control-fitted nonlinear gene-expression consumers respond perturbation-specifically when target embeddings are shifted. It does not establish causal steering of the original foundation models, unseen datasets, or wet-lab cellular state.
